cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The client asked who wrote our pitch. Will you tell her I copied it, or protect our partnership?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll withdraw it. Will you keep my name out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing doesn't answer her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then before you say yes, decide whether we're still partners when she puts down the phone.

mechanism: A uses authority over continued partnership to make an honest answer personally costly to the other partner.
confusable: Unlike denying the copying, A admits it and makes the choice about whether truth is worth the relationship.
comparison: Client honesty and partnership continuation differ from sibling promises and false blame.
seedUse: The seed's final condition on remaining partners gives S01 a concrete power claim beyond the prefixed decision language.
